description: Reviewed deviations between implemented SA 2024 bindings and the curated public binding facts in evidence/sa/2024.1.0508.5/bindings.json, checked by ExactTargetEvidenceCrossCheckTests (#290). Each reviewed entry suppresses exactly one finding (command, argument, implemented binding, kind). A reviewed family suppresses one documented adapter rule and pins how many distinct findings it covers. Stale entries and changed family counts fail the test.

reviewed_families.rationale: Documented 2024 adapter rule: the exporter names the three-argument SetCollectionObjectNameArg for collection-object inputs, and Briosa's reviewed adapter calls the four-argument SetCollectionObjectNameArg2, which the committed 2024 interop also exposes. The rule covers only implemented SetCollectionObjectNameArg2 setters whose fact names exactly SetCollectionObjectNameArg; a label, direction, or other method mismatch is still reported. On the first run it covered all 610 fact arguments that name SetCollectionObjectNameArg, across 440 operations; removing Mirror Object(s) (#310) left 609 across 439. The adapter is a portable mapping; broad 2024 runtime coverage remains outstanding.
reviewed_families.provenance: docs/development/sa2024-compatibility.md (Exact-target API differences); evidence/sa/2024.1.0508.5/README.md (collection-object setter); interop/SpatialAnalyzer/2024.1.0508.5/Briosa.SpatialAnalyzer.Interop.PublicApi.txt (SetCollectionObjectNameArg and SetCollectionObjectNameArg2); #285; #290 seed.

reviewed.command: Make a Collection Item Name Reference List - WildCard Selection
reviewed.rationale: The exporter names SetItemTypeArg, which is absent from the committed 2024 interop (bindings.json finding setter_method_absent_from_interop) and cannot be called. A licensed 2024 SDK/SA probe and a packaged 2024 RPC succeeded with SetStringArg (MP code 2) for 'Any'; ObjectiveSA uses the same setter. Other choices are not runtime-validated.

The exporter names SetMPGDTOptionsCheckValidatorTypeArg, which is absent from the committed 2024 interop (bindings.json finding setter_method_absent_from_interop) and cannot be called. A licensed 2024 SDK/SA probe and a packaged 2024 RPC succeeded with SetStringArg (MP code 2) for 'None'; ObjectiveSA uses the same setter. Other choices are not runtime-validated.

reviewed.command: Construct Polygonized Surface from Point Clouds
reviewed.rationale: The exporter names SetMeshOrientationTypeArg, which is absent from the committed 2024 interop (bindings.json finding setter_method_absent_from_interop) and cannot be called. The operation sends reviewed Mesh Orientation literals with SetStringArg. No licensed 2024 observation covers this substitution, so it remains at-risk.

reviewed.command: Make a Point Name - Ensure Unique
reviewed.rationale: Evidence-less getter: the captured 2024 signature records this name only as an input setter and no output. The operation reads the updated value back by the same name with GetPointNameArg, as reviewed for 2026. No licensed 2024 observation; at-risk.
